description: The command list that rises over the composer while a /word is being typed: Baude's own commands, then Claude Code's commands and skills, each with its arguments and what it does.
opens: type / at the start of the prompt, or at a word's start after a space or new line

parts.name: list
parts.shows: A popover above the box (a clear gap), its left edge on the /, as wide as the box up to a maximum. Each row: an icon (Claude's logo for Claude Code's built-in commands, a command-line icon for others), the command as "/name" and a dim line "also /alias · <argument hint> · <first line of its description>" (cut with …, the full description as a tooltip). Local commands first: /new (aliases /clear; "Start a fresh session"), /cd <path> ("Move the conversation to another folder"), /btw <question> ("Ask a side question: answered from this conversation, without adding to it"), /login [--console | --sso | --email <address>] ("Sign in to your Anthropic account (claude auth login)"), /logout ("Sign out of your Anthropic account (claude auth logout)"); then Claude's commands by name.
text: Move the conversation to another folder
Ask a side question: answered from this conversation, without adding to it
Sign in to your Anthropic account (claude auth login)
Sign out of your Anthropic account (claude auth logout)

decisions.said: The slash command list always starts at the box's left edge; it should open near the / unless it would run off screen (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app opens the / list (and an agent box's @ list) with its left edge on the / or @, shifted back only as far as needed to stay on screen.

parts.name: matching
parts.shows: Ranked: names starting with what is typed, then aliases starting with it, then either containing it, then descriptions containing it. A footer note says "{n} found", or "Nothing found" when none match.

actions.by: key Up / Down / Page Up / Page Down
key Enter or Tab, or click a row
actions.does: Puts "/command " in place of the /word with the caret after it; Enter does so only while a row is lit
Closes the list and sends what is typed
Closes the list and selects text
Closes the list; over "Nothing found" Esc does what it would have done (stop a turn)

parts.name: where it opens
parts.shows: Not for a / in a path (src/app) or a link (https://…), nor inside code (a fence or `span`), nor when the caret is not at the end of the word. Only the prompt's first word is a command to Claude Code; a later /word is words to Claude.

decisions.said: / only activates at the start of a prompt but should work anywhere, like @ (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app opens the command list for a / wherever a word starts, not only at the prompt's start; not inside a path, a link or code.
